unsupported: The company provides mobile, state-inspected processing for both domestic animals — beef, lamb, goats, and swine — and wild game such as antelope, deer, elk, and javelina.
Customers include ranchers and hunting families across Coconino, Maricopa, Verde Valley, and Yavapai counties, as well as local 4H clubs that the company sponsors.
Giles started the business to bring inspected processing directly to producers, eliminating the need to transport live animals long distances.
The mobile model, combined with state inspection for resale, allows ranchers and hunters to obtain retail-ready cuts while maintaining animal welfare and meat quality.
